perf.summary: Loop/local uses 'var' instead of an explicit type, violating the house 'explicit types' rule used elsewhere in the library.
perf.currentCost: `for (var i = 0; i < this.Nconts; i++)` uses inferred type. Not a perf cost, but inconsistent with the explicit-type house constraint and with the rest of the codebase.
perf.proposedChange: Use `for (int i = 0; i < this.Nconts; i++)` (explicit int).
perf.rationale: Consistency with the stated house constraint (explicit types only). No codegen change — purely stylistic/discoverability.
perf.risk: None. Identical IL; int is the inferred type already.
